pages.title: FREQMAN
pages.text: The $(item)Frequency Manager$() keeps lists of the frequencies you use: nets, repeaters (with their offset and tone), the club's simplex, weather channels. Each has a name, receive and transmit MHz, the mode (FM, DIG, USB, LSB, CW or AM), a CTCSS tone and notes, and under the list the $(l:radiocraft:propagation/band_plan)band plan$() says what the frequency is for.

Ins adds, Enter edits, Del deletes, Ctrl+Up and Down move one, F8 sorts by frequency. Lists are saved at once as .FRQ files.$(br2)Mark channels with Space and $(thing)F5$() sends them into a commercial mobile wired to the computer, from the knob position you choose (for a handheld, open the list's channels in CPS and program it by hand). The radio's other channels, and their keys, stay as they were. F6 reads a radio's channels into the list (without their keys).
A blank floppy and a band plan sheet.
